description.value: The study analyzed F-THK5351 PET retention in patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia and compared it with Alzheimer's disease and normal cognition groups using voxel-wise and ROI-based analyses.
Observational cross-sectional study of 48 participants with bvFTD, Alzheimer's disease, and normal cognition groups.

definition.value: bvFTD group showed higher F-THK5351 retention compared to the NC group

value: The bvFTD group showed higher bilateral retention in the medial frontal, dorsolateral prefrontal, orbitofrontal, anterior cingulate, insula, anterior inferior temporal, and striatum regions compared to the NC group.
The distribution of THK retention was consistent with cortical atrophy on the MRI images and the areas highly correlated with symptoms observed in bvFTD patients.

definition.value: AD group showed greater F-THK5351 retention compared to the NC group

value: The AD patients showed greater THK5351 retention in the bilateral medial and lateral temporal, inferior parietal, dorsolateral prefrontal cortices, and the precuneus compared to the NC group.

definition.value: bvFTD group had greater F-THK5351 retention than AD group

value: The bvFTD group had greater THK5351 retention in the inferior frontal cortices, anterior cingulate cortex, insula, and striatum regions (right > left).
There was no brain region showing greater THK retention in the AD group than in the bvFTD group.

definition.value: bvFTD group showed higher F-THK5351 retention than NC group in ROI-based analysis

value: The ROI-based analysis, performed after partial volume correction, revealed higher THK5351 retention as a whole in the prefrontal, orbitofrontal, medial frontal, anterior cingulate, amygdala, and striatum regions in the bvFTD group compared to the NC group.
The distribution of THK retention was consistent with cortical atrophy on the MRI images and the areas highly correlated with symptoms observed in bvFTD patients.
